2. Daily Summary
Safety equipment was delivered to the Warren Ranch High School job site on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, including gloves, earplugs, safety glasses, face shield components, and lanyards, along with six 10 lb. fire extinguishers. All items were left on site for crew use, and the foreman was notified of the delivery and the location of the items. Work was observed on the 1st and 3rd floors of Area F and in designated roof areas. Workers were wearing the appropriate PPE, and those working at heights were wearing fall protection and tied off to designated anchor points, including a framer operating a scissor lift on the 3rd floor and a framer operating a boom lift on the 1st floor. Roof crews were reminded that 100% fall protection must be maintained at all times. A fall protection harness kit and scissor lift YSD-36 were inspected and found to be in good condition. Interior conditions and progress were documented in Area F, where approximately half of the 3rd-floor area had been sprayed with insulation above the work areas. The Area F exterior was documented in preparation for upcoming exterior framing, and ongoing roof installation by another trade was observed in Area C.
3. Safety Measures Verified
PPE Compliance
Workers on the 1st and 3rd floors were observed wearing the appropriate PPE while performing their assigned tasks.
Fall Protection in Use
Scissor lift and boom lift operators were wearing harnesses and tied off to designated anchor points; roof workers were using harnesses with lanyards or retractable yo-yos and were reminded to stay tied off to approved anchor points at all times.
Fall Protection Equipment Inspection
Harness kit inspected: D-ring and lanyard intact with no signs of wear, damage, deterioration, or user modification.
Scissor Lift YSD-36 Inspection
Safety manual present and available, annual inspection tag current and valid, and fire extinguisher properly charged and available on the lift.
Fire Extinguishers
Six 10 lb. extinguishers delivered fully charged with the required inspection tags and left onsite for use as needed.
Safety Equipment Delivered
Gloves, earplugs, safety glasses, face shield parts, and lanyards left at the jobsite container for crew use; foreman notified of the location.
